entries.explanation: Defines Act 1 route graph, node sequencing, encounter links, reward pools, and referenced data files.
entries.parameter_guidance: Keep node IDs and next references consistent; update referenced pool or encounter IDs together.
entries.modification_impact: Changes route progression, available nodes, encounters, rewards, and dependent map or scene behavior.

entries.explanation: Defines Act 1 enemy identities, categories, and base combat statistics.
entries.parameter_guidance: Modify HP, attack, defense, or intent pool entries only with matching enemy IDs used by rosters.
entries.modification_impact: Changes enemy strength and classification in encounters.

entries.explanation: Defines card metadata, costs, targets, rarities, effects, and upgrade routes.
entries.parameter_guidance: Preserve card IDs and localization keys; keep upgrade effect fields compatible with consumers.
entries.modification_impact: Changes card behavior, reward presentation, deck play, and upgrade outcomes.

entries.explanation: Defines card selection pools used by reward offers.
entries.parameter_guidance: Ensure every listed card ID exists in card definitions and pool IDs match reward references.
entries.modification_impact: Changes which cards can appear and how many choices are offered.

entries.explanation: Defines curse identity, text keys, removability, and effects.
entries.parameter_guidance: Keep curse IDs aligned with event and card effect references.
entries.modification_impact: Changes curse effects, removal behavior, and displayed descriptions.

entries.explanation: Defines enemy combat intents, icons, text keys, timings, targets, and effect amounts.
entries.parameter_guidance: Use valid enemy IDs and effect kinds; keep intent text keys synchronized with translations.
entries.modification_impact: Changes enemy telegraphs and combat actions.

entries.explanation: Defines event options, previews, outcomes, effects, and return routes.
entries.parameter_guidance: Preserve option and event IDs referenced by route nodes; validate effect fields and return_route values.
entries.modification_impact: Changes event choices, player-state changes, feedback, and navigation back to the map.

entries.explanation: Defines relic effects, trigger paths, timing, domains, parameters, and tags.
entries.parameter_guidance: Keep trigger paths and execution boundaries valid for the runtime systems.
entries.modification_impact: Changes combat or shop modifiers and relic presentation.

entries.explanation: Defines rest-site options, effects, confirmations, and targeting requirements.
entries.parameter_guidance: Keep option IDs stable and ensure required target flags match UI handling.
entries.modification_impact: Changes healing, upgrades, curse removal, and confirmation flow.

entries.explanation: Defines reward contents, gold, consumables, relic availability, and card-choice pools.
entries.parameter_guidance: Ensure referenced pool, card, relic, and consumable IDs exist and pick counts are valid.
entries.modification_impact: Changes reward offers and player inventory progression.

entries.explanation: Defines shop offers, prices, services, allowed targets, and blocked feedback keys.
entries.parameter_guidance: Keep offer IDs unique and referenced card or relic IDs valid.
entries.modification_impact: Changes shop inventory, economy, service availability, and failure feedback.

entries.explanation: Defines the Warrior starting deck and shuffle configuration.
entries.parameter_guidance: Keep card IDs valid and counts nonnegative; preserve shuffle mode and RNG stream semantics.
entries.modification_impact: Changes the initial deck and early-run draw order.

entries.explanation: Provides the shared Godot theme referenced by main and settlement scenes.

entries.modification_impact: Changes shared UI styling, fonts, colors, and control appearance.

entries.explanation: Provides English localization strings used across gameplay and menus.

entries.explanation: Provides Simplified Chinese localization strings used across gameplay and menus.
entries.parameter_guidance: Preserve localization keys and keep coverage aligned with English entries.
